name: ethereal
title: Ethereal
description: Travelling-light and black-hole glow effects for React — pure CSS gradients and masks, no canvas or WebGL, driven by one shared ~60fps loop for every mounted instance. Installs a thin wrapper over the @theale/ethereal package so fixes ship via npm rather than being stranded in your tree.
author: Alexandre Schrammel <https://ale.design>
docs: The host must be `position: relative` and `isolation: isolate`, and the effect must be a CHILD of it — EtherealButton does this for you. To decorate something else, keep your content on `relative z-10` and render as the last child. Replaced elements (, ) cannot contain children: wrap them in instead. Full reference: https://ethereal.ale.design/llms-full.txt
